title: Asymptotic Stability of Rarefaction Waves for the Hyperbolized Navier-Stokes-Fourier System
summary: This paper investigates the asymptotic stability of rarefaction waves for a one-dimensional compressible fluid system, where the Newton's law of viscosity and Fourier's law of heat conduction are replaced by Maxwell's law and Cattaneo's law, respectively. The system, which generalizes the classical Navier-Stokes-Fourier equations, features finite signal propagation speeds. We consider the Cauchy problem in Lagrangian coordinates with initial data connecting two different constant states via a rarefaction wave of the corresponding Euler system.
